noloadingscreen.options.title: NoLoadingScreen Settings
noloadingscreen.option.enabled.tooltip: Turn the mod on or off.
noloadingscreen.option.allowMovementWhil: Move with the movement keys while the placeholder is active, using Space to rise and Shift to sink. Purely local: nothing is sent.
noloadingscreen.option.loadingOverlay.to: After the screen is gone, keep the current phase, the elapsed time and the progress bar on the HUD until the chunk underfoot has really arrived.
noloadingscreen.option.showJoinTime.tool: Print the total and the per-phase breakdown of each join into chat. With this off, both are still written to logs/latest.log.
noloadingscreen.phase.waitingWorld: Waiting for the server to send the world…
noloadingscreen.hud.configHint: Press Esc for the Disconnect button
